title: Why Do We Sleep?
paragraphs: Every night, people go to sleep, but why do we need it? Doctors say that most adults need seven to nine hours of sleep. Children and teenagers need even more.
Sleep is not the same all night. We go through cycles, and one cycle is about ninety minutes long. In each cycle, sleep is light at first, then deep, and then we have dreams.
During deep sleep, the body repairs itself. The brain also works: it stores the new information from the day, so we can remember it later. Scientists think the brain also cleans itself at night.
When people do not get enough sleep, they feel tired and it is harder to pay attention. They can also feel sad or angry more easily. So sleep is not lost time. It is necessary for a healthy life.
